title: selfcheck and backlog.py procs still call a fresh-transcript claude session an orphan: no caller passes fresh= to bl_procs.classify
goal: bl_selfcheck.check_orphans and backlog.py procs count a claude session whose transcript was written within the last 10 minutes as detached, as the sessions panel does, by passing fresh pids to bl_procs.classify (SP-fn7letri review G2 on ST-kxnlpycw clause 1).

run: import re,glob,sys;n=sum(len(re.findall(r'classify\([^)]*fresh=',open(f,encoding='utf-8').read())) for f in glob.glob('_tools/*.py'));print(n);sys.exit(0 if n else 1)

repro_reason: the end-to-end failure needs a live orphaned claude pid with a fresh transcript; the repro counts callers that pass fresh= to classify
